Signature (3, down from 4). Present in all four apps and placed as Applying says: a full-bleed hero on blog home; a distinct banner for every article, about page, product and project; strips per screen with their own leads; vignettes on empty states (blog/screenshots/state-search-empty-desktop-light.png); and the checkered ground strip everywhere. The hero lead is the best yet: an envelope pediment, columns, lit windows and a flag (blog/drawings/home-d1.png vs reference/screenshots/p1-desktop-light.png cabin). The banner regression from rc.3 is fixed. But the store's main signature, the product sprite, went backwards. The page-level tote is a padlock at 272px (products-canvas-field-tote-d2.png), 3 of 11 grid sprites slipped under 40% (home-desktop-light.png), and the 390px grid is still unverified. The hero path lost its corner diagonal and the store strip thinned. A design lead who knows the reference would not ship a padlock as the flagship product picture.

Reference fidelity (4): a night ground, cream pixel type, 4px windows with darker interiors, dither rules under h2s, one gold commit with a hard shadow, the gold ▶ marker, hue top bars and bullets, block meters, and a checkered grass strip, all as in reference/screenshots/p1-desktop-light.png, without its cabin, figure or snow. Cross-app consistency (4): one family. Avatars and header switches are now unified, and all four apps have meters. Drift: the blog's card width differs between home (6 columns) and article (3 columns). Hierarchy (4): scene and h1 first, then ruled h2s; the 48px KPIs lead the chart; the 48px price and gold Add to cart lead the product page. The blog home's posts are the weak spot (other issue 1). Spacing rhythm (4): the 4px scale, h2 rhythm and form widths hold. Soft spots are the cramped 6-column blog grid and the uneven dashboard panels. Component states (4): a gold focus ring on the invalid field, danger frames with '!' messages (commerce/screenshots/state-checkout-errors-desktop-light.png), a raised hovered card with ▶ (state-card-hover-desktop-light.png), a titled dialog with a framed close, Cancel and gold Confirm (settings/screenshots/state-plan-dialog-desktop-light.png), and an empty search with a vignette, a 0-of-6 meter and a framed Clear filters. Polish (4): radius 0, 2/4px borders and no default-browser leftovers.

Not penalized (known harness gaps): the sticky header captured mid-page in full-page state shots (commerce/screenshots/state-checkout-errors-desktop-light.png, blog/screenshots/state-search-empty-desktop-light.png); the dialog scrim ending at about 900px (settings/screenshots/state-plan-dialog-desktop-light.png); no real pending request; motion frames only on the first route, and here only for the blog.
